propositions.text: allowed returns a list of booleans the same length as timestamps, one verdict per request in input order.
Each request is bucketed into the fixed window starting at t - (t % window), equivalently t // window.
Within any single aligned window at most limit requests are permitted.
Requests are processed in the given order, permitting one while its window's permitted count is below limit and incrementing that window's counter.
Rejected requests do not consume capacity and do not count toward the limit.
Window counters reset at each window boundary, so a request in a fresh window is permitted even if the previous window was full.
An empty timestamps list returns an empty list.
timestamps is a list of integer second-timestamps given in non-decreasing order.
